verdict.rationale: The Commission runs public websites and an online filing system, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes, which govern crawler access. None of them document any analytics, cookie or tracking opt-out for users, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
